stem.text: Which statement explains why iodine is less volatile than chlorine?

A.text: Chlorine is more electronegative than iodine and so has more repulsion between its molecules.

B.text: The greater number of electrons in iodine leads to larger temporary dipole-induced dipole forces.

C.text: The $\text{I–I}$ bond energy is smaller than the $\text{Cl–Cl}$ bond energy.

D.text: The iodine molecules have stronger permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces.
